note: Ship 8 — Garden state persistence safety-net plus Presence overlap refix. Two real Garden bugs from Kirks chair test. Bug 1 Garden state lost on browser reset diagnosed as Opus case 3 — saves only fire on three specific in-game events at lines 2055 and 2305 and 2409 so if the co-creator evolves their Luminos and closes the tab without triggering one the evolution is lost. Fix adds persistAllLuminos walking the luminos array and calling saveEvolutionState for each non-visitor wired via beforeunload and pagehide and visibilitychange hidden and 60-second interval belt-and-suspenders. Persistence wires AFTER init so luminos exist before first save. Fail-quiet try-catch wraps the loop because tab-close must never block. Visitor Luminos NOT persisted they belong to others. Also adds resetGarden as Kirks dreamland seed for future expansion — clears EVOLUTION_STORE via objectStore clear plus localStorage fallback returning a Promise for future migration story. Bug 2 Presence pill covering Immerse button regression diagnosed as the rect-not-yet-rendered case — controls getBoundingClientRect returns zeros and Math max 46 0 plus 8 fell back to 46 the original bug position. Fix adds requestAnimationFrame retry bounded to 30 frames roughly 500 milliseconds when controls.bottom and controls.height are both zero. Also pointer-events belt-and-suspenders — outer indicator stays pointer-events none always so clicks pass through to garden buttons underneath even when visually offset. Children opt into pointer-events auto for hover. Peer-list shows on any child hover not on outer hover the regression site. Dropdown stays open when mouse moves into it. Gap increased from 8 to 12 pixels for visual breathing room. Eighteen smoke locks across both fixes plus the reset seed.
